subject.title: fix(web): provider caches split one URL across case-only variants

question: Should `canonicalizeUrlCacheDimension` become a supported shared plugin-SDK export, or should Firecrawl and Tavily keep equivalent URL-dimension normalization private until a broader provider-cache API is designed?
rationale: The implementation needs a legal extension boundary, but exporting a newly named helper from public SDK barrels creates a compatibility commitment that automated review cannot choose on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Accept the shared SDK helper
options.body: Keep the two barrel exports and treat the pure URL-dimension canonicalizer as the supported shared provider-cache primitive.

options.title: Keep normalization provider-local
options.body: Remove the new SDK exports and duplicate the tiny non-throwing normalization logic inside the two provider owners to avoid expanding the public SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared SDK helper
recommendation.body: Keep the two barrel exports and treat the pure URL-dimension canonicalizer as the supported shared provider-cache primitive.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the decision concerns the public extension boundary.
